Gary's last piece is stuck. You have 30 stages, 35 ridiculous tools, and one very brave butt. Every poop is a puzzle.

Credits

Gary's yelps, screams, moans, laughs, grunts, breath and burps, the wet squelches and the toilet flush are recordings from Oculus Audio Pack 01 by Oculus VR, LLC, licensed under CC BY 4.0. The clips were trimmed, level-matched and converted to MP3.

Gary's spoken lines were recorded ahead of time with the open Kokoro text-to-speech model (Apache 2.0), voice am_puck.

Everything else, including the music and the farts, is synthesized in your browser as you play.
